test_suite: AgroVision AI 2.0 - Phase 6 Automated Model Experiments Test Suite

test_results.message: All 4 strategy configurations validated with required schema properties and hyperparameters.
Verified local class index uniqueness and contiguous zero-based indexing for all 16 crop families.
Verified 100% bijective compatibility between crop router targets and Phase 2 canonical crop registry.
Verified complete mutual exclusivity of record IDs across train (16,237), val (3,521), and test (3,522) partitions.
Confirmed zero duplicate-group or perceptual hash overlap across all partitions.
Deterministic partition generator verified: run1 and run2 partition MD5 checksums are identical.
Verified preprocessing configuration: strictly 224x224 target size and RGB 3-channel input.
Verified physical model output dimension (Dense units = 72) matches 72-class unified label mapping.
Successfully reloaded Crop Router serialized checkpoint (crop_identity_router.pkl) in fresh test process.
Verified all inference predictions are strictly finite real numbers summing to 1.0 across all output classes.
Verified unsupported crops (coffee, tea, soybean) are excluded from model mappings, forcing engine abstention.
Verified scikit-learn metric calculations (accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro F1) on deterministic fixtures.
All required Phase 6 plan, criteria, comparison, and mapping artifacts verified on disk.
